name: concept
purpose: M1 한 컷 — 비율과 구도를 보는 그림. 도형+텍스처로 본 첫 화면. 예뻐도 성벽이 사람 다섯 키면 버린다.
prompt: The attached images are STYLE references only (classic Korean MMORPG pixel art). Study their color feel and slight 3/4 top-down view; do not copy any building or character from them. Draw a NEW original concept image of a small Korean traditional-fantasy village seen from a fixed camera placed to the SOUTH, tilted 40 degrees downward, in strict ORTHOGRAPHIC (parallel) projection — no perspective, objects at the back are exactly the same scale as objects at the front, like a classic 2D top-down RPG. Morning light from the UPPER LEFT, flat sky color #b9d4e6, no fog, no cast shadows. Everything is built from simple blocky 3D primitives (boxes, triangular-prism roofs, 4-sided pyramid roofs, thin cylinder posts, flat planes) covered in crisp pixel-art textures — it should look like a low-poly blockout with pixel textures, NOT a painting. Scale ruler: an adult person is 2 units tall. Layout, front (south) to back (north): FRONT ROW — five long single-story houses side by side with 2 units of gap, each 9 units wide, 3 deep, earth walls 2.5 tall, gray roof-tile gable roofs with the ridge at 4.0, eaves overhanging 0.5, four wooden posts at the corners, three doors on the south face (2.5 tall, 1.25 wide) spaced 3 units apart with one small window between doors, a sandy yard 2 units deep in front. The five houses differ ONLY by door color, left to right: navy #2f4f7a, moss green #4a5d3a, blue-violet #4b5f9e, navy #2f4f7a with small brass coin pattern #d8b25c, deep teal #1f5f4f (the fifth house is shorter: 6 wide, two doors). MIDDLE — a stone-paved plaza 15 by 9 units with two stone lanterns (2.5 tall) flanking a dirt road that leads north to the castle gate; a dirt road also runs south to the houses. LEFT of the plaza — a teahouse 6 by 5 units, same wall and roof as the houses, a wooden door with a cream bamboo blind, and a hemp-cloth awning (2.2 high, 2.5 deep) over five sitting spots in front. RIGHT of the plaza — the chief's house, a little larger: 5 by 4, walls 3.0 tall, 4-sided pyramid tile roof to 5.0, navy door with gold knocker. BACK — a stone castle wall 21 units wide and 5 tall with battlements, a gate opening 2.5 wide and 3 tall in the middle with dark interior and two open wooden doors, a gate pavilion on top (earth walls 2 tall, pyramid tile roof reaching 9 units above ground — the highest point in the picture), and behind the wall the tile roof of one large hall rising to 7. Place four small pixel-art people (2 units tall, hanbok in various colors, 1px dark outlines) for scale: one in front of a house, two in the plaza, one under the teahouse awning. Palette limited to these 32 colors only: #1b1a1f #3d3a44 #6f6d78 #a8a6ae #f4efe4 #d9d1bf #b7ab92 #f3d3b3 #d9a878 #a86f4a #6e4630 #8b5a2b #d8b25c #4a2c1a #4b5f9e #c96f3b #6b4a2f #4a5d3a #2f6b7a #9c3b2f #1f5f4f #7a3b52 #2f4f7a #a8541f #5b3a63 #8a7320 #2e4a2a #6f9a4a #a9c86a #5f8fbf #b9d4e6 #c94a3a. Textures are chunky pixels: each world unit is 32 texture pixels. No text, no UI, no name tags, no border. Landscape 16:9, 1920x1080 PNG.
after: 그대로 out/kit/concept.png 에 저장. 팔레트 스냅은 안 한다 — 이 그림은 화면에 안 올라가고 비율·구도만 본다. 대신 성벽 : 사람 = 2.5 : 1, 집 용마루 : 사람 = 2 : 1 인지 눈으로 재고, 어긋나면 프롬프트의 숫자를 고치는 게 아니라 다시 뽑는다.
status: 요청 파일만 있음 — 대표 손으로 ChatGPT 에 넣어 뽑는다 (2026-09-13)
